thumbnail_prompt:
ARM A - EVOLVED LOOK (final prompt, 2026-11-28):
16:9 YouTube thumbnail in traditional Indian miniature painting style (Kangra / Pahari school): flat perspective with no realistic 3D lighting, fine ink outlines, matte gouache colour, delicate patterned textiles, a stylised face in three-quarter profile. NO ornate border and NO parchment panel: the painting fills the frame edge to edge. Dawn palette: deep peacock-blue sky at the top fading to soft peach and gold at the horizon, a small golden sun just rising over distant hills, dark green trees. A single figure who has just woken: a woman standing on a simple stone terrace, stretching both arms overhead with a soft smile, eyes closed, facing the sunrise. Her face, arms and blouse are painted in light warm tones so she stands out clearly; pale cream blouse, soft gold patterned sari. A few birds in flight, a flowering branch reaching in from the top right corner, a small brass cup of tea on the terrace wall, no palace or domes. Simple clothing, no heavy jewellery. A bamboo flute resting on the terrace wall, small, not played. Text: "A GENTLE DAY" in a BOLD warm cream classical serif typeface with strong thick-and-thin strokes (the same heavy weight as a bold Roman book title), large, upper left, about two-thirds of the frame width, not covering the figure.

ARM B - CURRENT LOOK (control): the usual Raga Focus Pichwai-Kangra miniature - ornate floral border, cream parchment text panel (right ~40%), dark indigo serif. Same scene as Arm A. Text in the panel: "A GENTLE DAY".

Before the day asks anything of you - let it start softly.

Soft morning flute music for a gentle start: light, open phrases to wake up slowly, breathe, and set a calm tone for the whole day.
